adjudication.rationale: The diff does change the PUT /admin/groups/:id parameter contract: `update` used to read `payload = params[:group]` and now reads top-level `params[:alias_level]`, `params[:visible]`, `params[:name]`. If an old caller still sends `group: { visible: "true" }`, `params[:visible]` will be nil and `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"` will set `visible` to false (silent behavior change). However, the finding’s reference to a `params[:group][:visible]` nil-check is inaccurate (that code is removed), and within this PR the JS client was updated to send the new top-level shape (`Group#asJSON`), so this is primarily a backward-compatibility/API-change concern rather than a newly introduced internal defect.
